items.briefing:
Australian organisations are being urged to patch systems promptly after Rapid7 flagged two actively exploited vulnerabilities in Microsoft's September Patch Tuesday update — meaning attackers are already taking advantage of these flaws in the wild. Separately, a new report shows AI data exposure is the second most common AI-related security incident reported across Australia and New Zealand, a reminder that staff should be careful about what information they enter into AI tools.

Google has also warned that cyber attackers are increasingly using autonomous "agentic" AI to carry out attacks faster and at greater scale. **Practical tip:** Before typing anything into an AI tool, ask yourself whether that information would be safe to share publicly — if not, leave it out.

featured.title: SentinelOne adds OpenAI GPT-5.6-Cyber to AI services
featured.summary: Security teams could cut manual triage as the new service ranks code and intrusion risks by real-world exploitability, not alert volume.
